programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Love Mocktail
programme.desc: After rescuing a woman, Adi reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki
programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.title: Pighalta Aasman
programme.desc: Delhi-based businesswoman Arti Singh travels to Kashmir to claim her land from Suraj Arora. Soon after Arti and Suraj fall in love with each other, she learns that her friend Anu too loves him.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Yes Boss
programme.desc: Rahul's boss Siddharth is a womaniser who blackmails Rahul into helping him win over Seema. But Rahul ends up falling in love with Seema and is torn between his career aspirations and his sweetheart.

programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Action Time
programme.desc: A man is brought to a secret island by dark and mysterious forces. Now, he must save his mother from the grasp of evil figures who were disguised as guardian angels.

programme.title: Biwi.Com
programme.desc: When a pandit predicts that Kishan will marry thrice in his lifetime, his wife Shilpa forces him into a second marriage. When the wives start fighting, a third woman arrives from London for Kishan.

programme.title: Love Mocktail 2
programme.desc: With the semblance of leading a normal life, Adi struggles with the loss of his wife, Nidhi. However, Sihi, a charming young woman, enters as a glimmer of hope when she commits to helping Adi.

programme.title: Pyar Ki Kahani
programme.desc: Ram, a peon, forms a close friendship with a man named Ravi and values his opinion. However, he is shocked when Ravi disapproves of his fiancee and gets more upset when he learns the reason why.

programme.title: Dhadkan
programme.desc: Anjali and Dev are in love with each other and plan to marry, but her family gets her married to Ram. Years later, Dev shows up to reunite with Anjali, however, she has fallen in love with Ram.

programme.title: Koyelaanchal
programme.desc: An honest IAS officer rises against the atrocities of a brutal mafioso. In retaliation, the mafioso sends a deadly human weapon to kill the officer, who instead ends up abducting his child.

programme.title: Nazar Ke Samne
programme.desc: Jai, an unemployed drunk, gives false testimony that puts an innocent man in jail for murder. However, he later relents and tries to exonerate him by searching for the real killer.

programme.title: Satya
programme.desc: Durga's brother is killed in a gang war, turning him into a revenge-seeking man with a mission. Now, his ex-girlfriends cop husband is out to get him. Finally, the two team up to nab the real culprit.

programme.desc: Meeting for the first time in a final, 31-year-olds Jessica Pegula and Elina Svitolina vie for the Dubai crown. Svitolina bids to end an eight-year wait for her third title here. (21.02)

programme.title: ATP Final: Doha
programme.desc: Standing between Carlos Alcaraz, in the midst of an 11-game winning run, and a maiden Qatar Open title is the resurgent Arthur Fils - playing in his first final since 2024. (21.02)

programme.title: S/Lge: Bradford v Catalans
programme.desc: Impressing on their Betfred Super League return, Bradford Bulls go up against French outfit Catalans Dragons next. Catalans got off the mark with a strong home win over Huddersfield Giants.

programme.title: My Icon: Nigel Owens
programme.desc: In the next episode of this special series, esteemed Welsh rugby referee Nigel Owens discusses his experiences in sport, and his support for the Rainbow Laces campaign.

programme.title: S/Lge: Toulouse v Castleford
programme.desc: Returning to the Betfred Super League with a bang, Toulouse Olympique bid to build on an impressive round one performance as the French side welcome Castleford Tigers.

programme.title: My Icon: Kadeena Cox
programme.desc: In the next episode of this special series, British para-athlete Kadeena Cox discusses the individuals that have inspired her over the course of her career.

programme.title: My Icon: Keegan Hirst
programme.desc: In the next episode of this special series, Wakefield Trinity prop Keegan Hirst discusses the individuals that have inspired him during his life and career.

programme.title: PL Darts: Glasgow
programme.desc: The BetMGM Premier League visits Glasgow for night three of the season as Luke Humphries plays Josh Rock, while on Scottish soil, Welshman Gerwyn Price and Jonny Clayton collide.

programme.title: Darts Gold: Lloyd v Van Barneveld
programme.desc: A look back at some classic darts action. Here, then number one seed Colin Lloyd faces Raymond van Barneveld in the second round of the 2007 PDC World Darts Championship.

programme.title: MVG v Wade: Premier Lge 2015
programme.desc: Revisit a classic Premier League Darts contest from the Motorpoint Arena where Michael Van Gerwen dismantled James Wade in 2015 with an average of 116.90. Contains flashing images.

programme.title: WTA Doha 2026 Review
programme.desc: A review of the 2026 Qatar Open - the first WTA 1000 event of the season.
